recognize_zh: 這是多面板整合圖：左上 G-banding 核型 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23)[25]，框出 der(1) 與 der(11)；左下 metaphase FISH 以 KMT2A 分離探針顯示 1F1R1G 訊號，確認 KMT2A 重排；右側 A–D 為血液與骨髓抹片中的母細胞，E–F 為富含母細胞的高細胞性骨髓切片。診斷的關鍵在核型與 FISH，而非單看形態。
features: G-banded karyogram 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23)[25] with der(1) and der(11) boxed with ideograms
Metaphase and interphase FISH with KMT2A break-apart probe showing 1F1R1G pattern, split signals localized to der(1) and der(11)
Panel A (PB): neutrophil-sized cell reported as a doughnut (ring) nucleus, detail limited at this resolution
Panels B-D (PB and BM aspirate): large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Panels E-F (BM biopsy, H&E): hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
describe_en: This composite figure combines cytogenetic, FISH and morphologic panels. The G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(1;11)(q21;q23) in all 25 metaphases, and metaphase FISH with a KMT2A break-apart probe demonstrates a 1 fusion, 1 red, 1 green pattern with split signals on der(1) and der(11), confirming KMT2A rearrangement. Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate panels show large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and a cell with a ring-shaped nucleus is indicated in panel A, although small panel size limits cytologic detail. The trephine sections show a hypercellular marrow effaced by blasts. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with KMT2A::MLLT11 rearrangement, an adverse-risk genetic group under ELN 2022.

ddx.vs: t(9;11) is the most common KMT2A partner and is distinguished only by the partner chromosome on karyotype or fusion transcript testing, not by morphology.

ddx.dx: AML with 11q23 deletion or partial tandem duplication of KMT2A
ddx.vs: KMT2A-PTD is not detected by break-apart FISH or karyotype and requires molecular testing, whereas a balanced translocation with split signals indicates true rearrangement.
Recurrent KMT2A rearrangement defines AML regardless of blast count in WHO 5th edition, and the marrow here is effaced by blasts.
KMT2A rearrangements are frequent after topoisomerase II inhibitors, so prior cytotoxic exposure must be excluded clinically rather than morphologically.
